agents.label: AI native
agents.headline: Your AI reports for duty. You keep command.
agents.subhead: Blowhorn's actions are scripted to the letter, so any agent can drive them without guessing where to click. It gets your queue, your limits and a dry run before it fires.

cards.title: MCP server
cards.body: Every Blowhorn action on the MCP roster. Claude, Copilot, Grok Bot and any MCP-ready assistant can find it and use it, with your limits attached.

cards.title: REST API
cards.body: Planned: every action over HTTP, from the same schema as the CLI. Until it lands, use the CLI or MCP.

cards.title: Scriptable CLI
cards.body: Everything the app does is a command. --json for answers, --dry-run for drills, and a full published reference.

cards.title: Agent-tuned CLI
cards.tag: A field radio built for agents
cards.body: blowhorn-axi answers in TOON, a compact format agents read fast. A dry run unless told to fire, and a next step on every reply.

cards.title: AI skills
cards.body: Skills teach Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode the drill: read first, rehearse, then ask before firing.

cards.title: Model provider plugins
cards.tag: Blowhorn where your AI already works
cards.body: Plug Blowhorn into Codex, Claude, Grok Bot, Muse, Copilot and more. Your assistant gives the order; your computers carry it out.

agents.major: An agent with a dry run is a recruit. An agent without one is a liability. I only enlist recruits.

content.label: Content generation
content.headline: Your model or ours. Your voice either way.
content.subhead: Blowhorn posts what you write. Want help writing it? Pick where the words come from.

offers.title: Bring your own model
offers.body: Connect the model or assistant you already use and set rules per platform and profile. Blowhorn turns its drafts into scheduled posts.

offers.title: Blowhorn writes it
offers.tag: Drafts in your voice, built in
offers.body: Hand Blowhorn a changelog, a link or one line and get a draft for every platform, in your voice. Nothing posts until you approve it.
offers.price: An add-on, or included on larger plans.

content.note: Neither? Fine. Every plan posts exactly what you write, and we never charge per action.
